chapters.title: F1: a crash can drop an event
chapters.prose:
The handler sends the event before it commits the row. A crash between the two steps loses the event.

How to see it

Stop the process after the send and before the commit. The row is gone and nothing retries it.

The fix

Write the row and commit first. The worker sends it after the commit.
